# GroupDocs.Search documentation

> On-premise SDK docs for full-text search: building search indexes from PDF, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument, email, eBook, archive and image files, and running keyword, phrase, wildcard, regular-expression, fuzzy, boolean, faceted, synonym and homophone queries against them.
> Platforms: net | java | nodejs-java | python-net | mcp
> .NET TFMs: netstandard2.1 (NuGet package); the .NET system requirements page also lists net462

## Hubs

- https://docs.groupdocs.com/search/net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/search/java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/search/nodejs-java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/search/python-net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/search/mcp/
